headline: Central Bank of The Gambia Issues New Bank Employment Regulation
summary: The Central Bank of The Gambia directed commercial banks to replace non-Gambian employees with qualified Gambian nationals by December 31, 2026.
why: Employment regulations imposed by central banks can alter operational compliance and workforce structures for commercial banks operating within a jurisdiction.

impacts.name: Banking Sector
impacts.why: Commercial banks in Gambia must replace foreign staff with local nationals, altering their operational workforce.
